name: Events and trips
h1: Every student ready before the bus leaves.
sub: Event HQ tracks every student's fees, forms and registration for each concert, competition and trip.
get: Set registration deadlines, and event reminders go out automatically.

Trips get traveler rosters, payment packages and installment due dates, and adults who travel can be charged without creating fake student records. Parents can sign up to chaperone, with your approval.
cta: Plan your next trip in Program Partner.

faq.q: Can families pay for a trip in installments?
faq.a: Yes. Each package has its own schedule, and every installment shows up on the family's balance.

faq.q: What if the trip price changes?
faq.a: Create a new version of the package. You see each traveler's old and new totals before anything changes.
